description: A3 task 15b (#738; REQ-039, REQ-040): the pre-UAT closure of the body clear-gallery-adoption-20261113; no feature. check-01 runs scripts/refinement/task-115-closure.test.mjs (node:test): the A3 body record evidence/refinement/clear-gallery-adoption-20261113/BODY.json (integration base a6cd01c9, the task 2 review fixes on 2f023b9; accepted gallery bec4454; Foundation 0.14.3; main 03087f7, gallery eded158 and the old build 181e580 as history only) and the shared checker in final mode over the receipts of TASK-103 to TASK-114 and TASK-116 to TASK-121; the ancestry (HEAD descends from a6cd01c9, 181e580 never merged, main carries none of this body); TASK-121's receipt and the TASK-035/037/038 definition-record receipts current and passing; the body-level ledger (the A3 test ledger tool rerun with --now; every build test carried, rewritten, ported or retired with a note, none unplaced), its helper recheck and the eleven S6 bodies; the comparison page and its 52 receipts with every capture re-hashed from the evidence store; the eight recaptured owners' parity receipts; the whole e2e run record; and the UAT list for Eric (Q-007, the Focus control name, the Echo inside dialogs, X5, every R7-2 and R7-3 retirement, the carried “does not call an early finish a cap” body, TASK-121's retired claims and re-points). parity runs e2e/refinement/task-115-comparison.spec.ts: for each of the 26 accepted states at 320 and 390, its primary owner's end-of-run matched-data pair (gallery state and real route at the same moment over the same data) with every capture hash-checked in the store, the other end-of-run owners' pairs for the same state, every recorded difference labelled with its criterion or listed as unintended, and the state drawn again at the delivered revision (reduced motion, fixed clock, animations disabled, captured whole with TASK-110's wholePart); receipts in evidence/refinement/task-115/comparison/receipts/, captures in the evidence store under clear-gallery-adoption-v2-20261120/task-115/captures/; the last case writes evidence/refinement/task-115/comparison/index.html and opens it, every image loading. Every declared case must execute and pass.
